optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent performance degradation or system instability.
Review and potentially reconfigure AI system to ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Analyze trading strategies and execution to ensure trades are being executed correctly and results are accurately reported.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system slowdowns or crashes, affecting platform availability and user experience.
